subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour cron timeline as the first Control UI product slice, or require the broader daily/week calendar and rescheduling design before implementation?
rationale: This is a new Control UI capability, not a broken existing contract, and the active PR covers only part of the requested product scope while currently conflicting with main.

options.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR as a focused timeline strip, preserve the existing list/edit/run-history behavior, and track daily/week/drag-and-drop work separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope First
options.body: Pause the current implementation until maintainers define daily, week, stats, drag-and-drop, and validation behavior together.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR if maintainers decide the current list and run-history UI is enough for core.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR as a focused timeline strip, preserve the existing list/edit/run-history behavior, and track daily/week/drag-and-drop work separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the Cron Jobs page and broader Control UI ergonomics work.
